links.outcome: Intra-model score consistency across repeated runs and under ASR transcription noise
links.effect: Phi-4 and Gemma-2-9B ICC > 0.89 with minimal degradation under ASR; Llama-3.1-8B ICC dropped from 0.82 to 0.36 at 10% WER.
links.quote: Llama-3.1-8B shows ASR-fragile consistency, with ICC dropping from 0.82 to 0.36 at 10% WER

unlisted_practices: Evaluating evidence faithfulness (keyword groundedness) of LLM-cited evidence in mental health screening outputs

screen.reason: Evaluates LLMs and ASR models on a benchmark dataset for mental health screening across consistency, robustness, and faithfulness dimensions, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
